summary.key_theme: AI 需求帶動的強勁成長預期與分析師目標價調升，正面臨台灣廠區罷工威脅與專利訴訟和解金支出的短期壓力。

bullish.title: MU Stock Adds 3% As D.A. Davidson Forecasts Stock Value To Triple On Valuation Play
bullish.reason: D.A. Davidson 將目標價大幅調升至 3,000 美元，主要基於 AI 需求持續激增對記憶體晶片的長期利多。

bullish.title: Rosenblatt Lifts Micron’s Target to $1,900. The Cash Is There, The Buybacks Aren’t Yet.
bullish.reason: Rosenblatt 將目標價調升至 1,900 美元，強調公司現金流強勁，具備未來實施庫藏股的潛力。

bullish.title: Micron’s profits surge as Meta’s AI spending accelerates
bullish.reason: Meta 等大型科技公司持續擴大 AI 資本支出，直接推升 Micron 的營運利潤。

bullish.title: Best Momentum Stocks to Buy for October 7th
bullish.reason: Micron 被 Zacks 列入 #1 強力買進名單，反映出強勁的動能指標。

bullish.title: 3 Reasons Growth Investors Will Love Micron (MU)
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Micron 具備穩健的成長屬性，有助於其超越市場整體表現。

bearish.title: Micron Workers in Taiwan Authorize a Strike and Wants 15% of Operating Profit.
bearish.reason: 台灣廠區工會授權罷工並要求 15% 營業利潤作為獎金，引發市場對生產中斷與成本上升的擔憂。

bearish.title: Micron Agrees to Pay $600 Million to Resolve Netlist Patent Lawsuit
bearish.reason: 公司需支付 6 億美元和解金以解決與 Netlist 的專利訴訟，對短期獲利造成壓力。

bearish.title: Micron Technology (MU): Pullback Driven by Debates Over AI Capex Sustainability
bearish.reason: Artisan Partners 對 AI 資本支出的永續性提出質疑，導致市場對晶片股出現回調壓力。

bearish.title: Micron (MU) Stock Still Looks Expensive Despite Its Huge Five Year Run
bearish.reason: 儘管成長強勁，但部分觀點認為股價已處於高檔，估值偏貴。

neutral.title: What Is Really Behind Micron Stock's Run?
neutral.reason: 探討股價驅動因素，指出投資人應重新評估記憶體價格與公司獲利之間的關聯性。

neutral.title: MU vs. SIMO: Which Stock Should Value Investors Buy Now?
neutral.reason: 針對價值投資進行比較分析，未對 Micron 本身給出明確買賣建議。
